name: Iede Kissa ~Anata no Booth de Kasegasete~
original_name: 家出喫茶～貴方のブースで稼がせて～
source:
"Will you pay me for my body?"
Airi grew up spoiled and ran away from home in a bratty tantrum.
She's hiding out in a net cafe, but she's got to earn money.
She knows she sell herself, but does she understand?

Hot story of a mistress heroine pampering various types of men!

Your choices will change Airi's outcome!!!
Help her sell her virginity to the lowest creep!
